column1: # Line configuration for cdtest.features (ANALYSIS_PLAN.md section 3; signal per plan amendment v1.2).
# One row per candidate input set. For each `line`, the row with the LOWEST `priority` whose files for the
# requested signal all exist is used (signal=cpm: `insertions` glob matches >= 1 file AND peaks exist;
# signal=fc: fc_bigwig AND peaks exist). A line with no usable row is skipped and recorded in build_info.
# Paths are relative to the repo root. peaks: narrowPeak(.gz) or bigBed (.bb) narrowPeak.
# insertions: glob of per-replicate Tn5 insertion arrays (data/atac_ins/<Line>__rep<k>.npz; 0-based int32,
#   sorted, one array per chrom chr1-22,X). Replicates are pooled per line (counts summed).
# cn_line: column name in data/annot/cn_segments_log2.tsv (annot.CN_LINES); "none" = no CN correction.
